15: #ifndef GOOGLE_CLOUD_CPP_GENERATOR_INTERNAL_SERVICE_CODE_GENERATOR_H
16: #define GOOGLE_CLOUD_CPP_GENERATOR_INTERNAL_SERVICE_CODE_GENERATOR_H
17: 
18: #include "generator/generator_config.pb.h"
19: #include "generator/internal/codegen_utils.h"
20: #include "generator/internal/descriptor_utils.h"
21: #include "generator/internal/generator_interface.h"
22: #include "generator/internal/printer.h"
23: #include "google/cloud/status.h"
24: #include <google/protobuf/descriptor.h>
25: 
26: namespace google {
27: namespace cloud {
28: namespace generator_internal {
29: 
30: class ServiceCodeGenerator : public GeneratorInterface {
31:  public:
32:   ServiceCodeGenerator(
33:       std::string const& header_path_key, std::string const& cc_path_key,
34:       google::protobuf::ServiceDescriptor const* service_descriptor,
35:       VarsDictionary service_vars,
36:       std::map<std::string, VarsDictionary> service_method_vars,
37:       google::protobuf::compiler::GeneratorContext* context);
38: 
39:   ServiceCodeGenerator(
40:       std::string const& header_path_key,
41:       google::protobuf::ServiceDescriptor const* service_descriptor,
42:       VarsDictionary service_vars,
43:       std::map<std::string, VarsDictionary> service_method_vars,
44:       google::protobuf::compiler::GeneratorContext* context);
45: 
46:   ~ServiceCodeGenerator() override = default;
47: 
48:   ServiceCodeGenerator(ServiceCodeGenerator const&) = delete;
49:   ServiceCodeGenerator& operator=(ServiceCodeGenerator const&) = delete;
50:   ServiceCodeGenerator(ServiceCodeGenerator&&) = default;
51:   ServiceCodeGenerator& operator=(ServiceCodeGenerator&&) = default;
52: 
53:   Status Generate() override;
54: 
55:  protected:
56:   using MethodDescriptorList = std::vector<
57:       std::reference_wrapper<google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const>>;
58:   using ServiceConfiguration =
59:       google::cloud::cpp::generator::ServiceConfiguration;
60: 
61:   virtual Status GenerateHeader() = 0;
62:   virtual Status GenerateCc() = 0;
63: 
64:   VarsDictionary const& vars() const;
65:   std::string vars(std::string const& key) const;
66:   MethodDescriptorList const& methods() const { return methods_; }
67:   MethodDescriptorList const& async_methods() const { return async_methods_; }
68:   void SetVars(absl::string_view header_path);
69:   VarsDictionary MergeServiceAndMethodVars(
70:       google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method) const;
71: 
72:   void HeaderLocalIncludes(std::vector<std::string> const& local_includes);
73:   void CcLocalIncludes(std::vector<std::string> const& local_includes);
74:   void HeaderSystemIncludes(std::vector<std::string> const& system_includes);
75:   void CcSystemIncludes(std::vector<std::string> const& system_includes);
76: 
77:   Status HeaderOpenNamespaces(NamespaceType ns_type = NamespaceType::kNormal);
78:   Status HeaderOpenForwardingNamespaces(
79:       NamespaceType ns_type = NamespaceType::kNormal,
80:       std::string const& ns_documentation = "");
81:   void HeaderCloseNamespaces();
82:   Status CcOpenNamespaces(NamespaceType ns_type = NamespaceType::kNormal);
83:   Status CcOpenForwardingNamespaces(
84:       NamespaceType ns_type = NamespaceType::kNormal);
85:   void CcCloseNamespaces();
86: 
87:   void HeaderPrint(std::string const& text);
88:   void HeaderPrint(std::vector<PredicatedFragment<void>> const& text);
89:   Status HeaderPrintMethod(google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method,
90:                            std::vector<MethodPattern> const& patterns,
91:                            char const* file, int line);
92:   void HeaderPrintMethod(google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method,
93:                          char const* file, int line, std::string const& text);
94: 
95:   void CcPrint(std::string const& text);
96:   void CcPrint(std::vector<PredicatedFragment<void>> const& text);
97:   Status CcPrintMethod(google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method,
98:                        std::vector<MethodPattern> const& patterns,
99:                        char const* file, int line);
100:   void CcPrintMethod(google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method,
101:                      char const* file, int line, std::string const& text);
102: 
103:   /**
104:    * How the endpoint for the service might depend upon its location.
105:    */
106:   ServiceConfiguration::EndpointLocationStyle EndpointLocationStyle() const;
107: 
108:   /**
109:    * Whether a service is experimental. If true, we add the `ExperimentalTag` to
110:    * certain APIs.
111:    */
112:   bool IsExperimental() const;
113: 
114:   /**
115:    * Determines if the service contains at least one method that requires
116:    * LRO handling. This could be AIP-151 compatible or something custom.
117:    */
118:   bool HasLongrunningMethod() const;
119: 
120:   /**
121:    * Determines if the service contains at least one method that returns a
122:    * google::longrunning::Operation.
123:    */
124:   bool HasGRPCLongrunningOperation() const;
125: 
126:   /**
127:    * Determines if any async methods are generated for the service.
128:    */
129:   bool HasAsyncMethod() const;
130: 
131:   /**
132:    * Determines if the service contains at least one method that is paginated
133:    * per https://google.aip.dev/client-libraries/4233.
134:    */
135:   bool HasPaginatedMethod() const;
136: 
137:   /**
138:    * Determines if the service contains at least one rpc whose request or
139:    * response contains a field of the proto map type.
140:    */
141:   bool HasMessageWithMapField() const;
142: 
143:   /**
144:    * Determines if the service contains at least once rpc with a stream
145:    * response.
146:    */
147:   bool HasStreamingReadMethod() const;
148: 
149:   /**
150:    * Determines if we need to generate at least one asynchronous streaming read
151:    * RPC.
152:    */
153:   bool HasAsynchronousStreamingReadMethod() const;
154: 
155:   /**
156:    * Determines if we need to generate at least one asynchronous streaming write
157:    * RPC.
158:    */
159:   bool HasAsynchronousStreamingWriteMethod() const;
160: 
161:   /**
162:    * Determines if the service contains at least once rpc with a stream
163:    * request.
164:    */
165:   bool HasStreamingWriteMethod() const;
166: 
167:   /**
168:    * Determines if the service contains at least one bidir streaming RPC
169:    */
170:   bool HasBidirStreamingMethod() const;
171: 
172:   /**
173:    * Determines if the service contains at least one RPC with a
174:    * google.api.routing annotation.
175:    */
176:   bool HasExplicitRoutingMethod() const;
177: 
178:   /**
179:    * Determines if REST transport is enabled for the service.
180:    */
181:   bool HasGenerateRestTransport() const;
182: 
183:   /**
184:    * Determines if gRPC transport is enabled for the service.
185:    */
186:   bool HasGenerateGrpcTransport() const;
187: 
188:   /**
189:    * Determines if any of the method signatures has any Protocol Buffer
190:    * Well-Known Types per
191:    * https://developers.google.com/protocol-buffers/docs/reference/google.protobuf
192:    * and provides the necessary include path.
193:    */
194:   std::vector<std::string> MethodSignatureWellKnownProtobufTypeIncludes() const;
195: 
196:   /**
197:    * Determines if any emitted method signature uses a deprecated field.
198:    */
199:   bool MethodSignatureUsesDeprecatedField() const;
200: 
201:   /**
202:    * Method signatures are omitted if they contain deprecated fields, or if the
203:    * overload set conflicts with a previous method signature.
204:    */
205:   bool OmitMethodSignature(google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method,
206:                            int method_signature_number) const;
207: 
208:  private:
209:   void SetMethods();
210: 
211:   enum class FileType { kHeaderFile, kCcFile };
212:   static void GenerateLocalIncludes(Printer& p,
213:                                     std::vector<std::string> local_includes,
214:                                     FileType file_type = FileType::kHeaderFile);
215:   static void GenerateSystemIncludes(Printer& p,
216:                                      std::vector<std::string> system_includes);
217: 
218:   Status OpenNamespaces(Printer& p, NamespaceType ns_type,
219:                         std::string const& product_path_var,
220:                         std::string const& ns_documentation = "");

19: #include <google/protobuf/descriptor.h>
20: 
21: namespace google {
22: namespace cloud {
23: namespace generator_internal {
24: 
25: /**
26:  * Determines if the given method is a long running operation.
27:  */
28: bool IsLongrunningOperation(google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method);
29: 
30: /**
31:  * Determines if the given method's response is contained in the longrunning
32:  * metadata field.
33:  */
34: bool IsLongrunningMetadataTypeUsedAsResponse(
35:     google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method);
36: 
37: /**
38:  * Sets longrunning operation related key/value pairs in method_vars.
39:  */
40: void SetLongrunningOperationMethodVars(
41:     google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method,
42:     VarsDictionary& method_vars);
43: 
44: /**
45:  * Determines if the method uses `google::longrunning::Operation` types for
46:  * long running operations.
47:  */
48: bool IsGRPCLongrunningOperation(
49:     google::protobuf::MethodDescriptor const& method);
50: 
51: /**
52:  * Sets longrunning operation related key/value pairs in service_vars.
53:  */
54: void SetLongrunningOperationServiceVars(
55:     google::protobuf::ServiceDescriptor const& service,
56:     VarsDictionary& service_vars);
57: 
58: }  // namespace generator_internal
59: }  // namespace cloud
60: }  // namespace google
61:
